label: Shopee
terms_note: Developer account + app on open.shopee.com; apps pass Shopee's review before going live (test → live); shop owner authorises (365-day max, re-authorise), tokens per shop_id / merchant_id; signature timestamps valid 5 min; rate limits per API (published on each endpoint page, not read here); sandbox environment; Shopee commission + payment fees per market.

discovery.auth: hmac + oauth-style shop authorisation (partner_id + partner_key; sign = HMAC-SHA256(partner_key, partner_id + path + timestamp [+ access_token + shop_id]); code 10 min → /api/v2/auth/token/get; access_token 4 h, refresh_token 30 d, max authorisation 365 d)
sdks: community SDKs (e.g. PHP shoapi); official Postman / test tools on the Open Platform

auth: 1. Register a developer account + app on open.shopee.com → partner_id + partner_key; pass app review (test → live).
2. Generate the authorisation link (partner_id, timestamp, sign, redirect); the seller logs in and grants; Shopee returns code (10 min) + shop_id.
3. POST /api/v2/auth/token/get → access_token (4 h) + refresh_token (30 d); refresh via /api/v2/auth/access_token/get; re-authorise before 365 days.

endpoints.notes: item_name, description, original_price, seller_stock, item_sku, category_id, image, logistic_info, weight, dimension, brand, attribute_list, condition, item_status → item_id

reference.limits: Per API, published on each endpoint page (not read here); 5-minute signature window. - Open Platform developer terms; app review before live; seller authorisation per shop. - One API set across all Shopee markets.
mcp_sdk: SDK: community SDKs (e.g. PHP shoapi); official Postman / test tools on the Open Platform

config_fields.name: partner_id
config_fields.help: partner_id of your Shopee Open Platform app (Console > App).

config_fields.name: shop_id
config_fields.help: shop_id of the authorised shop (returned in the authorisation redirect).

fields.name: partner_key
fields.help: partner_key (live key) of the app; signs the token refresh and every shop call (HMAC-SHA256). Never sent on the wire.

fields.name: refresh_token
fields.help: refresh_token from GetAccessToken (/api/v2/auth/token/get) after the shop authorised the app (https://open.shopee.com/developer-guide/20). Valid 30 days and rotated on every refresh; set PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR so the newest one survives restarts.

me.note: v2.shop.get_shop_info: shop_name, region, status and the authorisation expire_time.

list_orders.note: v2.order.get_order_list: orders created from `since` (required; the window up to now may be at most 15 days) newest pages via next_cursor. `status`: UNPAID, READY_TO_SHIP, PROCESSED, SHIPPED, COMPLETED, IN_CANCEL, CANCELLED, INVOICE_PENDING. Amounts and items: v2.order.get_order_detail (not mapped).

mark_shipped.note: v2.logistics.ship_order for NON-INTEGRATED logistics channels: ships order `order_id` with the carrier's `tracking_number` (non_integrated.tracking_number). Integrated channels need pickup/dropoff details from v2.logistics.get_shipping_parameter and are not mapped; `carrier` is not sent.

set_inventory.note: v2.product.update_stock: sets the seller stock of item `listing_id`; `sku` is the model_id (0 for an item without variations). Check `failures` (failure_list with failed_reason).

update_listing.note: v2.product.update_price: sets the original price of item `listing_id` without variations (model_id 0) in the shop's local currency. Items with models need per-model prices (not mapped); title/description edits (v2.product.update_item) are not mapped.

not_offered.create_listing: v2.product.add_item (https://open.shopee.com/documents/v2/v2.product.add_item?module=89&type=1) requires category_id, image.image_id_list from v2.media_space.upload_image, logistic_info channel settings, weight and brand; the vocabulary's create_listing has none of these inputs.

adapter.terms: Shopee Open Platform v2: shop APIs carry partner_id, timestamp, access_token, shop_id and sign = HMAC-SHA256(partner_key, partner_id + api path + timestamp + access_token + shop_id); access tokens last 4 hours and are refreshed through the signed RefreshAccessToken API (/api/v2/auth/access_token/get), which rotates the 30-day refresh_token (https://open.shopee.com/developer-guide/20).

evidence: host partner.shopeemobile.com: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (Let's Encrypt)
probe: 6/6 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route -> 404 (not_found), so the answers are path-specific
HTML docs spot-check (render-doc): 5/5 tool paths found verbatim on their docs pages; every parameter and body key named on the page
